card.category: Chinese digital-content marketplace — claims unlimited hosting
card.summary: Their help centre says '面包多提供无限制的文件托管和高速下载服务(文件<1G)'. Unlimited file hosting, with a per-file note of <1 GB. So: unlimited total, 1 GB per object.

record.category: Chinese digital-content marketplace — claims unlimited hosting

free_tier.stated: Their help centre says '面包多提供无限制的文件托管和高速下载服务(文件<1G)'. Unlimited file hosting, with a per-file note of <1 GB. So: unlimited total, 1 GB per object.

egress.terms: No published egress cap; download is buyer-facing.

record.interface_detail: Web; some developer/OAuth surface for payments (afdian-style), but no public upload API found.
record.chaining: Unlimited x 1 GB is exactly the shard shape that works. But registration is the blocker, see identity_cost.
record.reliability_note: Creator registration has been repeatedly closed or tightened ('极大的限制甚至在某些时候关闭新创作者的注册'), and payout requires 实名认证 with ID + bank details. This is the classic Chinese-platform wall.
